description: Schedule the pi agent turn and expose public control, stable state, and state flux files; on_start / on_stop fire the after_start / after_stop hooks and on_before_run / on_after_run fire before_run / after_run around each turn, all through aos-hook; the last two only while their flag file is in the stack (hook_before_run.flag, hook_after_run.flag), which after_start sets from the hooks lists.
